description: This file defines the interface ProductToGLAccountMappingWritePlatformService which provides methods for creating and updating mapping configurations between financial products (loan, savings, share products) and general ledger accounts. It declares method signatures without implementations, indicating its role as an interface in the accounting product-to-GL account mapping module.

methods.name: createLoanProductToGLAccountMapping
methods.description: Creates a GL account mapping for a specific loan product identified by loanProductId, using parameters from the JsonCommand.

methods.name: createSavingProductToGLAccountMapping
methods.description: Creates a GL account mapping for a savings product identified by savingProductId, with additional account type specification.

methods.name: updateLoanProductToGLAccountMapping
methods.description: Updates the GL account mapping for a loan product, considering whether the accounting rule has changed and other mapping details.

methods.name: updateSavingsProductToGLAccountMapping
methods.description: Updates the GL account mapping for a savings product, with parameters indicating whether the accounting rule has changed and the account type.

methods.name: createShareProductToGLAccountMapping
methods.description: Creates a GL account mapping for a share product.

methods.name: updateShareProductToGLAccountMapping
methods.description: Updates the GL account mapping for a share product, considering whether the accounting rule has changed.
